name: sb-template-vue-vite
description: A Vue 3 + Vite template to start your client-side web applications quickly.
author: Stefano Biddau

_comment_dependencies.typescript: held at 6.x: TypeScript 7 waits for typescript-eslint (peer <6.1.0) and @volar/typescript, used by vue-tsc (peer <7), to accept it (note typescript@7.0.2)
_comment_dependencies.@types/node: held at 24.x on purpose: the types follow the Node runtime, and the project runs Node 24 (.nvmrc, engines, CI, Netlify) (note @types/node@26.6.11)
_comment_dependencies.eslint-plugin-vue: 10.12.1 lists @stylistic/eslint-plugin ^2-^5 as an optional peer while 6.x is installed: accepted, its Stylistic-based vue/* rules are not used here; 10.13.0 adds ^6 (note eslint-plugin-vue@10.13.0)
_comment_dependencies.minimatch: transitive, advisory GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249 (lint tooling only): minimatch 10 stays through @typescript-eslint/typescript-estree 8.72.2 until @vue/eslint-config-typescript or @intlify/unplugin-vue-i18n ask for 8.74+ (note minimatch@11.0.1)
